title: Palabras word entry
description: One Peninsular (Castilian) Spanish vocabulary entry, A2-oriented. One JSON file = exactly one entry object, stored as content/words/<id>.json. The id is the stable primary key: es-<ascii-folded headword slug>-<2-digit sense ordinal>, lower-case ascii with hyphens, accents and enye folded (melocoton, panaderia), e.g. es-nevera-01. Once assigned an id never changes, even if the headword/gloss is later edited; a rejected entry keeps its id and moves status to rejected.

id.description: Stable key. es-<ascii-folded headword slug>-<2-digit sense ordinal>. Never reassigned.

headword.description: Spanish headword with correct orthography (accents, enye). Multi-word entries use a single space, e.g. 'fin de semana'.

article.description: Only for nouns. Definite article of the headword; plural-only nouns (gafas, zapatillas) take los/las.

cefr.description: CEFR level of this sense as taught. Seed batches stay at A1/A2.

variant.description: Pins the entry to Peninsular/Castilian Spanish. Latin American (es-419) usage is never the taught variant.

scope.description: peninsular-generic = understood across Spain; navarre = Navarre-typical; pamplona = city-specific.

register.description: Dominant register of the taught sense. 'vulgar' requires registerNotes.

senses.description: One item = one sense: its own English gloss and its own Spanish example. Do not merge two meanings into one sense.

alternatives.description: Pre-generated replacements the reviewer can pick from when rejecting/editing the entry. The running app never generates these.

status.description: Lifecycle. draft -> pending_review -> approved | rejected | needs_change. rejected/needs_change keep the entry and its alternatives so the reviewer can pick one.

method.description: hand-authored = written by an agent/human; council = offline multi-model agreement step.

run.description: Council run identifier when method=council, e.g. run-20261017-a.

review.description: Reviewer-loop state, written by the review flow, not by authoring.

chosenAlternativeId.description: Alternative value the reviewer chose, or the already-approved word id it is replaced by.

notes.description: Authoring uncertainty: whether the word is Peninsular-only or shared, register doubts, level doubts. Required in spirit whenever confidence is low.

lint.description: Escape hatch for the content linter. Use sparingly and only with notes explaining why.

acceptedEs.description: Accepted Spanish answers. Defaults to the headword when absent.

acceptedEn.description: Accepted English answers. Defaults to the gloss split on comma-space when absent.

accentsAreThePoint.description: Enforce accents for this sense rather than accepting accent-only misses. Defaults to false.

gloss.description: English gloss for exactly this one sense.

example.description: Spanish sentence a Pamplona speaker would actually say. At most 12 words, Peninsular lexicon, Peninsular orthography.

kind.description: Why this alternative is offered. regional = another variety's word (the reviewer may still accept it); register = same meaning, different formality.

value.description: The alternative word/phrase the reviewer can pick instead.

gloss.description: English gloss of the alternative. Null when the alternative is just another variety's word for the same gloss.

reason.description: Short, concrete justification: why this is offered and when to prefer it.

targetId.description: Id of an existing entry when the alternative is already in the corpus.

example.description: Optional Spanish sentence showing the alternative in use.
